BIK 353 + NeccykCuNe DEVELOPMENTRIGHTSDEED THIS INDENTURE, dated the & day of March in the year two thousand five, between LANCEY REALTY LLC a New York limited liability company, having an office at 138 Delancey Street, New York, New York, hereinafter designated as the “Grantor", and NORFOLK HUDSON LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o On The Level Enterprises, Inc., 58 Thomas Street, New York, New York 10013, hereinafter designated as the "Grantee". WITNESSETH: That the Grantor, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($1o.oo)and other valuable consideration paid by the Grantee, does hereby grant and release unto the Grantee, and the heirs orsuccessors and assignsoftheGrantee,forever: CERTAIN unused transferable development rights (the "Transferred Development Rights"), amounting to approximately eleven thousand four hundred (11,400) square feet of "residential floor area" as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of The City of New York, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"), inhering in and attributable to (above, through and under an existing building) that certain real properly formerly owned by Grantor being in the Borough of Manhattan, located at 128 Delancey Street, City and State of New York, being Borough of Manhattan (the "Premises"). TO HAVE AND TO HOLD said Transferred Development Rights herein granted unto the Grantee, the successors and assigns of the Grantee forever. TOGETHER WITH all development rights now or hereafter inhering in or attributable to attributable to the Premises by virtue of any amendment of the Zoning Resolution or any other development rights inhering in and attributable to the Premises as hereinabove described, and does not otherwise convey title to thePremises. The Grantor, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, covenants that the Grantor will receive the consideration for this conveyance and will hold the right to receive such consideration as a trust fund for the purpose of paying the cost of the improvement and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvements before using any part of the same for any other purpose. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Grantor has caused its corporate seal to be hereunto affixed and has executed this deed by having it signed by its duly authorized officer, and Grantee has duly executed this Deed, the day and year first above written.
